headline: Meghmani Organics Limited: Copy of Newspaper Publication
sum: Copy of Newspaper Publication — Meghmani Organics Limited has informed the Exchange regarding the newspaper publication of the notice for the hearing of the Company s petition for the proposed Scheme of Amalgamation involving Kilburn…
detail: Copy of Newspaper Publication — Meghmani Organics Limited has informed the Exchange regarding the newspaper publication of the notice for the hearing of the Company s petition for the proposed Scheme of Amalgamation involving Kilburn Chemicals Limited and Meghmani Crop Nutrition Limited (Transferor Companies) with Meghmani Organics Limited (Transferee Company), along with their respective shareholders and creditors.
